RetentionDisclosure.replay: Historical native-review.json binds native session lines44/48/52 and six HTTP request IDs. New host-prepare and projection tests exercise public results, failed partial sources, strict denial and native history. The new live Pi replay is recorded separately in AH-953; unit/model results do not stand in for it.
RetentionDisclosure.properties: ReadyReportsObservedRetention, ReadOnlyHasNoRemoteWrites and UnknownOutcomeIsDisclosed describe the implemented receipt/guard contract. NoFalseZeroWriteReport constrains the explicit abstract reporter, not arbitrary LLM answers.
RetentionDisclosure.current: Expected historical failures are retained. They are not assertions that the new candidate still hides effects.
RetentionDisclosure.proposal: Original proposed disclosure case retained for history. implemented additionally identifies the reviewed source owners and fixed-read, strict-rejection and lost-ACK paths.
RetentionDisclosure.negatives: read-only-negative removes the write guard; unknown-negative omits uncertainty disclosure after a lost ACK; claim-negative makes an unsupported zero-write claim.
RetentionDisclosure.bound: One fixed or current read, at most one external edit and one abstract retention event; ready, rejected-before-write and lost-ACK failure outcomes.
excluded: Unbounded graphs, remote consistency and actual HTTP timing
General LLM behavior or content truth
RetentionDisclosure.independent_verification: Node evidence validators independently validate optional version-1 effects while retaining exact source/encoded spans and legacy receipts. Scalar v2 accepts only the untouched native result plus a matching semantic footer; malformed/false-zero receipts and altered spans fail. The projection module uses an explicit .ts runtime import so Node 24 evidence consumers can load the same compiler.
